prompt: A screening test reports 24 positives: 18 are true positives and 6 are false positives. Find P(condition | positive).
solution: Among 24 positives, 18 truly have the condition: 18/24=0.75.

prompt: Among 80 students who studied, 60 passed. Find P(pass | studied).
If P(A | B)=0.30 and P(B)=0.40, find P(A and B).
solution: Multiply conditional probability by the condition: 0.30×0.40=0.12.
